products.label: JPL Small-Body Database, trans-Neptunian orbit class
products.process: Take every object the Small-Body Database classes as trans-Neptunian that has no object package and a condition code of 6 or better; carry its osculating orbit to the world's epoch as an unperturbed ellipse; draw one dot at that position.
limitations: The dots are the objects found so far: they gather where surveys have looked and thin out with distance, because fainter objects go unseen.
An object whose orbit is known more loosely than condition code 6 is not drawn.
No color is taken from the database; every dot is the neutral grey the app gives a body without a measured color, and its size and opacity are display choices.
